info.title: Zladovce API
info.description: API of the Zladovce shop. Errors are RFC 9457 Problem Details with a stable `code` and Serbian text. Endpoints under /api/v1/admin require an Amazon Cognito access token. Request members listed as `required` must be sent (a nullable one may be null); a missing member gives 400 VALIDATION_FAILED with the field in `errors`. 409 SLUG_TAKEN and SKU_TAKEN also carry `errors` pointing at the field (`slug`, `sku`, `variants[i].sku`).

get.summary: Liveness: the process is running. Does not touch the database.
Readiness: the database is reachable.
Public store settings: name, logo, contact, social links, delivery and shipping, SEO defaults.
Slugs and last-modified times of the visible categories and products, for prerendering and the sitemap.
get.description: Same visibility as the public catalog. Blog posts are added in a later phase as a new member.

post.summary: Place an order (cash on delivery). 201 new order; 200 replay of the same request with the same Idempotency-Key.
post.description: Header `Idempotency-Key` (UUID) is required: generate it once when the checkout page opens and send the same key with every retry of that submission. Only a successful order uses up the key; after a 409/400 the same key may be sent again with the corrected cart. A request with a used key and the same content returns the original order (200, `trackingCode` null); with different content 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. Prices, shipping and totals are computed from the database with the rules of the cart quote; stock is deducted at once. `trackingCode` is always null until tracking codes are introduced (Phase 6). Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED (field paths such as `customer.phone`, `address.postalCode`, `items[0].quantity`, `acceptedTerms`, `idempotencyKey`), BAD_REQUEST (malformed JSON); 409 with the fresh quote in `quote`: CART_CHANGED (a line unavailable or reduced, `knownUnitPrice` or `expectedTotal` differs; `errors` names the lines), INSUFFICIENT_STOCK (stock taken meanwhile; `errors["items[i].quantity"]`), MINIMUM_ORDER_NOT_MET, SHIPPING_DISABLED; 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; 429 RATE_LIMITED (5 per 10 minutes per IP, `Retry-After` header in seconds).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: UUID generated by the browser once per checkout submission and repeated on every retry of it.

get.summary: Active categories in display order, with the number of visible products.
An active category with its SEO data.
Product grid: visible products with the listing price (lowest variant price) and availability.
get.description: Visible = active, not archived, in an active category, with at least one active variant. Sort `bestselling`: pieces sold in Delivered orders whose delivery is in the last 90 days (`Catalog:BestsellerWindowDays`), same metric as `/catalog/bestsellers`; products without such sales follow, newest first. Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED.

get.summary: Product page: variants with prices and availability (never the exact stock), images, SEO.
Other visible products of the same category (featured first, then newest). `limit` 1–12, default 4.
Best-selling visible products from real Delivered orders of the last 90 days. `limit` 1–24, default 8.
get.description: Ordered by pieces sold (ties: newest product first). Only products that sold in that window are listed, so the list is empty until orders are delivered; nothing is invented. Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED.

get.summary: Live price and availability of variants (for prerendered pages and the cart).
get.description: `variantIds`: up to 100 ids, repeated (`variantIds=a&variantIds=b`) or comma-separated (`variantIds=a,b`). Variants that are not on sale are missing from the result. Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED.

post.summary: Prices the browser cart from the database: lines, adjustments, subtotal, shipping, minimum order, total.
post.description: The client sends variant ids and quantities only; every price comes from the database. Lines with the same variant are merged. A variant that cannot be bought (unknown, inactive, archived, hidden product or category, out of stock) is left out of `lines` and reported as `unavailable` in `adjustments`; a quantity above `maxOrderQuantity` is reduced and reported as `quantityReduced`; with the optional `knownUnitPrice` a different current price is reported as `priceChanged`. Shipping is charged unless the subtotal is at or above the free-shipping threshold; the minimum order compares the subtotal. `canCheckout` is false when shipping is disabled, there are no lines or the minimum is not met. The exact stock is never returned. Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED (`items` empty or more than 50, `items[i].quantity` not 1–99, `items[i].variantId` missing or empty, `items[i].knownUnitPrice` invalid, a required member missing); 400 BAD_REQUEST (malformed JSON, a value of the wrong type such as a malformed uuid).

get.summary: The signed-in administrator and role.

post.summary: Pre-signed browser upload (multipart POST straight to the storage) for a product or category image.

get.summary: Variants with status `low` or `out` (at or below their low-stock threshold), emptiest first. `limit` 1–100, default 10.
get.description: Same rows as `GET /admin/inventory?status=low,out` (`totalItems` matches); the dashboard card should link there. Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED.

get.summary: All categories that are not archived, with product counts.

post.summary: Create a category. The slug is generated from the name when not given.
post.description: Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED, INVALID_IMAGE, UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND; 409 SLUG_TAKEN (`errors.slug`), IMAGE_NOT_READY, IMAGE_ALREADY_ATTACHED.

put.summary: Set the display order of all categories.
put.description: Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED (must list every non-archived category exactly once).

get.summary: A category.

put.summary: Update a category. Empty slug keeps the current one; `imageKey` null removes the image.
put.description: Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED, INVALID_IMAGE, UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND; 404 NOT_FOUND; 409 SLUG_TAKEN (`errors.slug`), IMAGE_NOT_READY, IMAGE_ALREADY_ATTACHED.

delete.summary: Archive a category. Refused while it has products that are not archived.
delete.description: The category image is removed with it: `image` is cleared in the same save and the image files are deleted afterwards. Errors: 404 NOT_FOUND; 409 CATEGORY_HAS_PRODUCTS.

get.summary: Products with price range, stock summary and main image.

post.summary: Create a product with at least one variant; each variant gets its stock record (and an InitialStock movement when above 0).
post.description: Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED (also unknown/archived categoryId); 409 SLUG_TAKEN (`errors.slug`), SKU_TAKEN (`errors.sku` for the product SKU, otherwise one `errors["variants[i].sku"]` per taken variant SKU, i = index in the request).

get.summary: A product (archived ones too) with its variants, stock and images.

put.summary: Update product values. Requires the `version` last read; a stale version gives 409 CONCURRENT_EDIT.
put.description: Replaces every value: all members of the body must be sent. Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED; 404 NOT_FOUND; 409 CONCURRENT_EDIT, SLUG_TAKEN (`errors.slug`), SKU_TAKEN (`errors.sku`), NO_ACTIVE_VARIANT, PRODUCT_ARCHIVED.

post.summary: Archive a product (hidden everywhere, slug and SKU become reusable). Idempotent.

post.description: Errors: 404 NOT_FOUND; 409 SLUG_TAKEN (`errors.slug`), SKU_TAKEN (`errors.sku`) (reused meanwhile), CATEGORY_ARCHIVED.

post.summary: Add a variant with its opening stock. Returns the whole product.
post.description: Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED; 404 NOT_FOUND; 409 SKU_TAKEN (`errors.sku`), PRODUCT_ARCHIVED, CONFLICT (50 variants).

put.summary: Update a variant (stock is changed through the inventory endpoints). Returns the whole product.
put.description: Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED; 404 NOT_FOUND; 409 SKU_TAKEN (`errors.sku`), LAST_ACTIVE_VARIANT, PRODUCT_ARCHIVED.

delete.summary: Archive a variant. Returns the whole product.

post.summary: Attach an uploaded image (key from upload-url). The first image becomes the main image. Returns the whole product.
post.description: Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED (key not a product upload key), INVALID_IMAGE, UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND; 404 NOT_FOUND; 409 IMAGE_NOT_READY (processor still running, retry), IMAGE_ALREADY_ATTACHED, IMAGE_LIMIT_REACHED (20), PRODUCT_ARCHIVED.

put.summary: Set the order of all images and the main image (null = first). Returns the whole product.
Change the alt text of an image. Returns the whole product.

delete.summary: Remove an image and its files; the next image becomes main when needed. Returns the whole product.

get.summary: Variants (of products that are not archived) with stock, threshold and status.
get.description: `status`: `ok`, `low`, `out`; several values comma-separated (`status=low,out`) and/or repeated (`status=low&status=out`) match any of them. `status=low,out` returns exactly the rows counted by `GET /admin/dashboard/low-stock` (link the dashboard card there). Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED.

post.summary: Manual stock correction with a mandatory reason. Atomic; stock never goes below zero.

put.summary: Set the low-stock threshold of a variant.

get.summary: Stock movements of a variant, newest first, with the administrator's name.
Orders with search, status and date filters, sorting and paging.
get.description: `q`: order number, customer name (ignores case and diacritics), email, phone. `status`: several values comma-separated and/or repeated. `from`/`to`: Serbian local dates (yyyy-MM-dd), inclusive. `sort`: newest (default), oldest, totalDesc, totalAsc. Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED, BAD_REQUEST (malformed date).

get.summary: Number of orders per status (all eight, zero included), e.g. for the menu badge (Received).
Order detail: contact, address, items, totals, payment, timeline, notes, shipments and the allowed next statuses.

post.summary: Move the order to the next status (P1.5). Returns the updated order.
post.description: Allowed: Received → Accepted | Rejected | Cancelled; Accepted → Preparing | Cancelled; Preparing → Shipped | Cancelled; Shipped → Delivered | DeliveryFailed; DeliveryFailed → Shipped | Cancelled; Delivered, Cancelled, Rejected are final. Shipped requires `shipment` (active courier; tracking number, date (default now), note optional). Stock returns automatically on Rejected and on Cancelled before shipping; cancelling after DeliveryFailed requires `restock` (true = goods back on stock). History, shipment, stock movements and audit are one transaction. Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED (`shipment`, `shipment.courierCompanyId`, `shipment.shippedAt`, `restock`); 404 NOT_FOUND; 409 INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION (with `allowedNextStatuses`), CONCURRENT_EDIT (stale `version`).

post.summary: Add an internal note without changing the status. Returns the updated order (`notes`).
post.description: Does not change `version`. Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED; 404 NOT_FOUND.

put.summary: Correct a shipment: courier, tracking number, date, note. Returns the updated order.
put.description: Every member must be sent. The courier must be active unless it is the shipment's current one. Does not change the order `version`. Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED (`courierCompanyId`, `shippedAt`); 404 NOT_FOUND.

put.summary: Record the amount actually collected from the courier and when, or clear it (`collectedAmount` null).
put.description: Delivered orders only. Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED (`collectedAmount`, `collectedAt`); 404 NOT_FOUND; 409 ORDER_NOT_DELIVERED, CONCURRENT_EDIT.

get.summary: Courier companies by sort order and name. `activeOnly=true` for the shipment form; default lists all.
A courier company.

put.summary: Change a courier company (Owner). Deactivate with `isActive: false`; couriers are never deleted.

get.summary: All store settings (Owner).

put.summary: Replace the store settings (Owner). Every member must be sent; `version` as last read.
put.description: The logo is not changed here. Shipping changes apply to the next quote and order at once. Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED; 403 FORBIDDEN (Staff); 409 CONCURRENT_EDIT.

Bearer.description: Amazon Cognito access token of an administrator (group Owner or Staff).
